title: Eratosthenes sieve dynamics beyond 2p: code, data and verification
description: Code, data and verification scripts accompanying version 3 of the preprint by T. Hojka, "Exact dynamics of Eratosthenes sieve beyond 2p: coincident fusions, births of gaps and missing differences" (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23007182). Release 2.0.0 adds the exhaustive verification of Part I, the exact models of Holt for gaps up to 150 computed with a second exact method, witnesses for Ziller's table of missing differences, the survival test up to 10^9 and the computations on minimal windows of Part II. Code is licensed under MIT; data and documents under CC BY 4.0.
